{{Current events|year=2026|month=05|day=19|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***[[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s kill 19 people and injure 34 in the [[Nabatieh District]] and the [[Tyre District]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://aje.news/pymo91?update=4587432 (Al Jazeera)] [https://aje.news/pymo91?update=4587371 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****The [[Israeli Navy]] intercepts a [[flotilla]] boat taking part in the [[Global Sumud Flotilla]] that was to be headed for the [[Gaza Strip]] in a effort to break the [[Blockade of the Gaza Strip|blockade]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-896663 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
***A [[Syria]]n [[Syrian Army|soldier]] is killed and at least twelve others are injured in a [[car bomb]] explosion in [[Damascus]].  [https://thenewregion.com/posts/5410 (''The New Region'')]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[United States Africa Command|U.S. African Command]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]] and [[Nigerian Armed Forces|Nigerian forces]] have launched airstrikes on a [[Islamic State|ISIS]] camp in [[Nigeria]]. [https://gazettengr.com/u-s-nigerian-forces-launch-third-attack-on-isis-camp-in-north-east/ (''Peoples Gazette'')]
**The [[Nigerian Defence Headquarters]] confirms that around 175 ISIS, [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|ISWAP]], and [[Boko Haram]] militants have been killed since the [[2026 United States-Nigeria strikes against Islamic State targets|joint operation]] launched by the [[United States]] and [[Nigeria]], including second-in-command [[Killing of Abu-Bilal al-Minuki|Abu-Bilal al-Minuki]]. [https://guardian.ng/news/175-boko-haram-iswap-fighters-eliminate-in-nigeria-us-joint-operations-dhq/ (''The Guardian Nigeria'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The Sudanese Emergency Lawyers reports that 28 people have been killed in a [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on a market in [[West Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/africa/28-killed-in-a-drone-strike-on-a-market-in-sudans-west-kordofan-rights-group-says/article_9ac35c9c-3271-50ae-adb6-751c8240e15a.html (''Toronto Star'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 California wildfires]]
**At least 10,000 homes are evacuated amid spreading wildfires in [[Santa Rosa Island (California)|Santa Rosa Island]] and  [[Simi Valley, California|Simi Valley]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg4pn0e2yp6o (BBC News)]
*Ten people are killed in torrential rain and flooding in [[Guizhou]], [[Hubei]], and [[Hunan]] provinces, [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/least-10-killed-heavy-rains-drench-southern-central-china-2026-05-19/ (Reuters)]
*The death toll from a [[pickup truck]] crash in [[Huanjiang Maonan Autonomous County]], [[Guangxi]], China, rises to ten after the bodies of nine missing people were recovered. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/least-10-killed-heavy-rains-drench-southern-central-china-2026-05-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The death toll in the [[Ebola]] outbreak in eastern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] rises to 131. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/ebola-deaths-eastern-congo-rise-131-outbreak-spreads-2026-05-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[Sudan]] begins implementing Ebola measures, including screening passengers at the [[Port Sudan New International Airport|international airport]] in [[Port Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/314157 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[2023–2026 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Thailand]] reports two cases of [[mpox]], prompting the [[Department of Disease Control (Thailand)|Department of Disease Control]] to increase surveillance of the disease. [https://www.nationthailand.com/health-wellness/40066396 (''Nation Thailand'')]

'''International relations'''
*The [[cabinet of Thailand]] approves plans to reduce the length of [[Visa policy of Thailand|visa-free stays]] for travelers from more than 90 countries as part of measures targeting [[Crime in Thailand|crimes]] involving foreign nationals. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/5/19/thailand-cuts-visa-free-stays-citing-crime-by-foreigners-1816 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**Former [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Prime Minister of Spain|prime minister]] [[José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero]] is charged with [[money laundering]] and membership of a criminal organisation in connection with an investigation into the alleged laundering of the €53 million public bailout that incumbent prime minister [[Pedro Sánchez]]'s [[second government of Pedro Sánchez|second government]] provided to the airline [[Plus Ultra Líneas Aéreas|Plus Ultra]] and La Liga Airlines in 2021. [https://www.politico.eu/article/spain-court-charges-key-pedro-sanchez-ally-with-money-laundering/ (Politico)]
*[[Catalonia]]n [[Mossos d'Esquadra|police]] arrest [[Jonathan Andic]], the son of [[Mango (retailer)|Mango]] founder [[Isak Andic]], as part of an investigation into Isak's death during a hiking trip to [[Collbató]] in 2024. [https://cebudailynews.inquirer.net/729786/breaking-mango-founders-son-arrested-in-spain-over-fathers-death (AFP via ''Cebu Daily News'')]
*[[Vietnam]]ese [[People's Public Security of Vietnam|police]] arrest five Chinese nationals and a local accused of operating a [[Gold laundering|gold smuggling]] network in [[Hanoi]] that allegedly traded more than [[United States dollar|US$]]45 million worth of gold. [https://www.nst.com.my/amp/world/region/2026/05/1443654/five-chinese-nationals-nabbed-alleged-us45mil-gold-smuggling-ring (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]], [[2026 Somali presidential election]]
**[[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***Opposition coalition [[Somali Future Council]] says [[Somalia|Somali]] [[President of Somalia|president]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] can no longer perform key presidential functions, including military oversight or dismissing government officials. They propose that [[List of speakers of the Parliament of Somalia|parliamentary speaker]] [[Aden Madobe]] serve as acting president until elections scheduled for 30 June. The president has lost full executive authority following the expiry of his mandate on 15 May. [https://www.idilnews.com/hsm-stripped-of-executive-power-as-term-expired-on-15-may/ (''Idil News)]
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[War Powers Resolution]], requiring a halt to hostilities in [[Iran]] not approved by the [[United States Congress]], passes a preliminary vote in the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] by 50–47 after the defection of [[Louisiana]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] senator [[Bill Cassidy]]. The vote comes after previous attempts failed. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/19/senate-advances-measure-to-end-military-action-in-iran-in-rebuke-to-trump.html (CNBC)]
